pairs.statement: A commercial contract is proved by official or private deeds, an accepted invoice, letters, the parties' books, or by witnesses or any other means the court accepts.
The action on the defect guarantee is time-barred one year after delivery, even if the defect was found later, unless the seller undertook a longer period.

Before a claim in which the petition asks for rescission and works performed defectively is yes, a prior step must have been taken, except when: Rescission may be claimed at once when correction is impossible.
Before a claim in which dispute concerns real property is yes and property registered is yes, the petition must be published at the land registry.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not require publication before filing the claim. It requires presentation at the first hearing and allows proof of lodging for publication.

pairs.statement: In other cases the judge may, in urgency, order provisional execution with or without security.
Where all or part of the price is payable at once, the seller may keep the thing until he is paid, unless he gave the buyer time after the sale.

Where the seller guaranteed the thing would work for a set time and a fault appears, the buyer must tell him within a month of its appearance and sue within six months of telling him, unless agreed otherwise.
Where neither the contract nor the law fixes the damages, the judge assesses them; they cover the loss suffered and the gain missed, when these are the natural result of the non-performance or delay.

Where the contractor is shown to work defectively or contrary to the contract, the client may warn him to correct within a reasonable time the client fixes; if it passes without correction, the client may claim rescission or have another contractor finish at the first one's cost.
The price of the work is paid when the work is taken over, unless custom or agreement says otherwise.
Any interested person may rely on the absolute nullity of a contract and the court may declare it of its own motion.
With several defendants, the court of the domicile of any one of them has jurisdiction.
If the thing sold perishes before delivery through no act of the seller, the sale falls and the buyer recovers the price, unless it perished after the buyer was put on notice to take delivery.
The obligation is valued when the act was made, and witnesses are allowed when only the accessories, added to the principal, take it above the sum fixed.
No one may sue without standing and an existing or potential interest the law recognises.
When the contract is rescinded the parties are put back where they were before it; if that is impossible the court may award compensation.

In commercial matters other than bankruptcy and judicial settlement, the claim goes to the court of the place of the promise, of delivery of the goods or of payment; against a company, to the court of one of its branches.
Contracts transferring ownership of real property, real rights or a business must, on pain of nullity, be drawn up in official form, with the price paid before the public officer.
This prior step is not required when: Rescission may be claimed at once when correction is impossible.
A works contract ends when the work contracted for becomes impossible.
A works contract is one by which a party undertakes to make a thing or do a work for a price the other undertakes to pay.
In real-property matters and works relating to real property, the claim goes only to the court where the property lies or where the works are carried out.
The contract is the law of the parties: it is undone or changed only by their agreement or for a cause the law provides.
Outside commercial matters, a juridical act worth more than the sum the article fixes, or of undetermined value, cannot be proved or shown discharged by witnesses, unless a text provides otherwise.
Sale is a contract by which the seller undertakes to transfer the ownership of a thing or another financial right to the buyer for a price in money.
In a contractual obligation, a debtor guilty of neither fraud nor gross fault owes only the damage normally foreseeable when the contract was made.
Agreed damages are not owed if the debtor proves the creditor suffered no harm.
Delivery is made by putting the thing at the buyer's disposal so that he can take possession and use it without hindrance.
What an official deed records is proof until it is shown to be forged.
The buyer may claim rescission for a shortfall in quantity only if he proves it was so serious that he would not have bought had he known.
The losing party bears the costs, unless the judge, giving reasons, puts them on another party.
The nullity action is lost fifteen years after the contract was made.
The time limit is 10 years, running from the date of contract date; it is a forfeiture period, counted by the method excludeFirstDay; it applies when the petition asks for annulment.
pairs.missingOrWrong: «خلال خمس (5) سنوات». The five-year period starts from the specified events, while ten years from contract completion is an outer limit only for mistake, fraud or duress: «لغلط أو تدليس أو إكراه». The TEXT gives no excludeFirstDay counting rule.

pairs.statement: Disputes on supplies, works and the hire of technical or industrial services go to the court of the place where the agreement was made or performed.
The seller guarantees the qualities he promised and the absence of defects that reduce the value or use of the thing, even if he did not know of them.
When a contract is void or annulled the parties are put back in their former position; if that is impossible, equivalent compensation may be awarded.
The client may withdraw from the contract and stop the work before completion, compensating the contractor for his expenses, the work done and the profit he would have made.
The right to have a contract annulled is lost if not asserted within five years.
In a bilateral contract with obligations due on both sides, each party may withhold performance while the other has not performed.

The annulment period runs from the end of the incapacity, the discovery of the mistake or fraud, or the end of the duress; annulment for mistake, fraud or duress cannot be claimed once ten years have passed since the contract was completed.
The judge may reduce agreed damages if the debtor proves they are excessive or that the obligation was partly performed.
When the debtor cannot perform in kind he is ordered to pay damages for non-performance unless he proves an outside cause; the same holds when he is late.
The creditor proves the obligation; the debtor proves he is released from it.
A clause giving territorial jurisdiction to a court that lacks it is void, unless made between traders.
In a bilateral contract, when one party fails to perform, the other may, after putting the debtor on notice, claim performance or rescission, with damages where warranted.
The contract must be performed as it is written and in good faith.
Witnesses may not be used to prove against or beyond what an official deed contains, whatever the value.

A petition concerning a published property or real right must be published at the land registry and produced at the first hearing, on pain of formal inadmissibility unless its lodging for publication is proved.
Witnesses may prove what must be proved in writing where there is a beginning of written proof.
The president of the commercial section must first refer the dispute to mediation.
The seller must deliver the thing sold to the buyer in the state it was in at the time of the sale.
The judge may give the debtor time, and may refuse rescission when the unperformed part is of little importance compared with all the obligations.
The price falls due when the thing is delivered, unless agreement or custom says otherwise.
The buyer's right to a price reduction or rescission for a shortfall or excess in quantity is time-barred one year after actual delivery.
If the thing sold lost value before delivery through damage, the buyer may ask for rescission where the loss is serious, or keep the sale with a lower price.
The time limit is 15 years, running from the date of contract date; it is a limitation period, counted by the method excludeFirstDay; it applies when the petition asks for annulment.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The fifteen-year rule concerns «دعوى البطلان» in the absolute-nullity context («باطلا بطلانا مطلقا»). The TEXT does not state excludeFirstDay counting, expressly classify the period as a limitation period, or give this rule for annulment generally.

pairs.statement: Territorial jurisdiction lies with the court of the defendant's domicile, or his last domicile, or the chosen domicile, unless the law provides otherwise.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not make the last domicile an unconditional alternative: it applies «وإن لم يكن له موطن معروف».

pairs.statement: Actions on that guarantee are time-barred three years after the collapse or the discovery of the defect.
The seller must do what is needed to transfer the right sold and refrain from anything that makes the transfer hard or impossible.
On pain of formal inadmissibility, the petition must contain a short statement of the facts, the requests and the grounds.

The time limit is 1 year, running from the date of goods delivery date; it is a limitation period, counted by the method excludeFirstDay; it applies when the petition asks for rescission and quantity shortfall claimed is yes.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT does not state excludeFirstDay counting. Its starting event is specifically actual delivery: «تسليم المبيع تسليما فعليا».

pairs.statement: Provisional execution is ordered on request where the judgment rests on an official deed, an acknowledged promise or a final judgment, and in maintenance and custodial-housing matters.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT excludes judgments already enforceable by operation of law from this on-request rule: «باستثناء الأحكام الواجبة التنفيذ بقوة القانون».

pairs.statement: In a sale of goods or other movables with a term set for paying the price and taking delivery, the sale is rescinded by law in the seller's favour, without warning, if the price is unpaid at the term, unless agreed otherwise.
Rescission may be claimed at once, without fixing a time, when correcting the defect in the way the work is done is impossible.
The architect and the contractor are jointly liable for total or partial collapse, and for defects threatening the soundness, of what they built, for ten years.
The parties may fix the damages in advance in the contract or a later agreement, subject to the rules on damages and notice.
pairs.missingOrWrong: The TEXT says that articles 176–181 apply, but does not give their contents or identify any notice rule.
